How do I apply for an Extension internsh: Extension internships typically open in Spring and Summer. Prepare a resume, unofficial transcript, and 1 recommendation. Watch the Extension site and campus emails for postings. You can email extension@alcorn.edu for the current cycle.
What scholarships are available for Exte: General scholarships are listed on Alcorn Financial Aid. Extension sometimes posts program-specific awards; check the Extension announcements page and ask your department coordinator.
Where can I find workshops or training?: Workshops run monthly during the semester. See the Extension Events calendar. Typical topics: agriculture, sustainability, entrepreneurship, health, and digital skills.
Who do I contact if I still need help?: Email extension@alcorn.edu or call the Extension office. For course-specific help, contact your department’s Extension coordinator.
